`242-245`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Make the progress-reset tests discriminating.** The existing edit and TodoWrite assertions pass without the reset logic. Add cases that distinguish clearing `window` from clearing `signaled`. The first identical edit is progress. Later identical edits are not. The seven-call alternating fixture fires at call 7. If only `window` clearing is removed, it fires at call 6. The fire-progress-fire cases correctly expect `[3, 7]`.
🧪 Suggested discriminating tests
```diff - assert.deepEqual(fires([test, test, sameEdit, test, test, test]), [6], "a new edit resets the window"); + assert.deepEqual(fires([test, test, test, sameEdit, test, test, test]), [3, 7], "a new edit clears the signaled set so the same loop can fire again"); + assert.equal(editReset.saved.length, 2, "each signalled failing loop saves a recovery checkpoint"); + + const windowReset = loopFixture(); + const windowTest = () => windowReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()); + const windowEdit = () => windowReset.call("edit", { filePath: "a.md", oldString: "x", newString: "y" }, okOut()); + assert.deepEqual(fires([ + windowTest, windowEdit, windowTest, windowEdit, + windowTest, windowEdit, windowTest, + ]), [7], "progress clears stale window entries"); ``` ```diff - assert.deepEqual(fires([ - () => todoReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()), - () => todoReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()), - () => todoReset.call("todowrite", { todos: [{ content: "Fix test", status: "in_progress" }] }, okOut()), - () => todoReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()), - () => todoReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()), - ]), [], "a todo status change is progress"); + const todoFail = () => todoReset.call("bash", { command: "npm test" }, failOut()); + const todoChange = (status) => () => todoReset.call("todowrite", { todos: [{ content: "Fix test", status }] }, okOut()); + assert.deepEqual(fires([todoFail, todoFail, todoFail, todoChange("in_progress"), todoFail, todoFail, todoFail]), [3, 7], "a todo status change clears the signaled set"); ```
